notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (11): Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself, Yavin 4: Massassi War Room, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Death Star: Detention Block Corridor, Leia Organa, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Echo Base Garrison; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Death Star Detention Block Corridor' dested the Light Special Edition site Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (the plain page is the Dark Premiere site); 'Yavin 4 War Room' dested Yavin 4: Massassi War Room.
Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace), the card named Artoo before Theed Palace; Artoo, Brave Little Droid postdates the post.

Posted 'I did It' dested I Did It!; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'Nar Shadda Wind Chimes' dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; 'Swing and a Miss' dested Swing-And-A-Miss; 'It's a Trap' dested It's A Trap!.
Don't Do That Again is the Tatooine Effect (not a Defensive Shield in this era); it is in the 60.
The strategy's update suggests swapping As Good As Gone, Rycar Ryjerd and I'm Here To Rescue You for Wise Advice, There Is No Try, Inconsequential Barriers and Obi-Wan; the list is kept as posted.
